adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the booking is loaded with `user: { include: { destinationCalendar: true, credentials: true } }`, but those organizer credentials are never used. Instead, the code builds the `EventManager` with `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)` (the caller) and spreads `...user` (the caller) into the manager, then calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)`. Since the authorization allows non-organizers (`isAttendee` or team admin/owner) to call this mutation, the calendar update can run with the wrong actor’s credentials (caller may have no connected calendar), after the DB update has already occurred, leading to a silent failure/no-op or error updating the organizer’s calendar state.
